configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Everything on by default: xTB, CPU integrals via libfint, libxc. What CI builds.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Debug flags: -fcheck=all and -ffpe-trap. Expect a large baseline of failures, most of them inside libfint rather than this project -- see CMAKE_STYLE.md.

configurePresets.name: libcint
configurePresets.description: The C integrals library. Compiles different source (no fused sp shells), so CI builds it too.

configurePresets.name: xtb-only
configurePresets.description: No CPU integrals and no libxc, so a configure touches the network far less. GFN1/GFN2 and fragmentation only.

configurePresets.name: serial
configurePresets.description: pic-mpi's single-rank backend. For a machine with no MPI at all.

configurePresets.name: coverage
configurePresets.description: Coverage-mqc, which is the only build type the coverage flags are applied for. libxc turns itself off here.

configurePresets.name: perlmutter
configurePresets.description: GPU nodes at NERSC, under nvfortran with Cray MPICH. Needs CUEST_ROOT pointing at the unpacked libcuest archive. See CMAKE_STYLE.md for what each of these is working around.

testPresets.name: mqc
testPresets.description: This project's own tests. mctc-lib and dftd4 add theirs unconditionally; the filter is what leaves them out.
